candidate.audited_claim: The current public CLDD generation path can produce only 180 CLDD-A rows and therefore cannot structurally generate the documented 360-row CLDD-A.

verified_history: At a78a871c2e83d9f1f1e24aea1b749f790f579eb7 (2026-07-08), ERROR_STREAM_SEEDS has length 5 and EVALUATION_SEEDS has length 10. task_CLDD_A appends only oracle evaluation directories, so that historical function structurally supplies 3 boundaries × 6 strategies × 10 evaluation seeds = 180 directories to collect_dataset.
Commit f186455e3f39a8b3ac2e37b941cdbb8a7e8ecedb on 2026-07-22 21:31:01 UTC changes ERROR_STREAM_SEEDS from five to N_TRIALS=10; its task_CLDD_A still has only the 180 evaluation-directory path.

The immediately following commit bf1635fa860d90ce9e08750762edf4be0c2a6127 on 2026-07-22 22:00:32 UTC adds nine lines to dodo.py. At that revision task_CLDD_A first appends the 180 oracle evaluation directories and then appends one error_stream directory for every 3 boundaries × 6 strategies × 10 ERROR_STREAM_SEEDS = 180 additional directories.

The same bf1635f commit changes the datasheet from 10 to 20 CLDD-A seeds and from 180 to 360 configurations, and adds a dataset test asserting len(CLDD_A)==180*2, despite a stale assertion message/docstring phrase still saying 180.

Current main retains the two-loop task_CLDD_A structure with 10 ERROR_STREAM_SEEDS and 10 EVALUATION_SEEDS. collect_dataset emits exactly one row per supplied directory. Therefore current source structurally supplies and writes 180 + 180 = 360 CLDD-A rows if all dependencies exist and load successfully.

The two deterministic seed lists use random.Random(0) and random.Random(1); direct recomputation gives ten distinct values in each list and no overlap, hence 20 distinct seed values across the current CLDD-A union.
assessment.material_correction: The clean worker's statement that current task_CLDD_A has no second source of 180 rows is false. The second source is explicit in current dodo.py: error_stream directories are appended after the oracle evaluation directories. Raw parquet access is not required to reject the current-source cardinality claim.
remaining_provenance_gap: The Zenodo description says the dataset has 10 training seeds and 10 test seeds while each detector was tuned using five training error streams. Current main instead creates/tunes from 10 ERROR_STREAM_SEEDS. Thus current source can structurally produce 360 CLDD-A rows but is not an exact replay of the documented five-stream detector-tuning procedure.

The July-8 source matches the five-tuning-stream statement but only structurally produces 180 CLDD-A rows. The July-22 pair of commits first raises tuning/error streams to 10 and then adds those 180 error-stream rows to CLDD-A while updating the datasheet to 360. This chronology is a plausible public packaging lineage, but it does not by itself prove the exact code/dependency state that produced the uploaded Zenodo parquet.

Actual uploaded CLDD_A.parquet row count, exact seed set, duplicated/missing rows, and detector-hyperparameter provenance still require reading the binary artifact or an authoritative parquet footer/archived generation log.
